questions.question: Moses told the Israelites to bring offerings to the Tent of Meeting because of what was going to happen that day. What was it?

answers.text: The LORD would appear to them

questions.question: After Aaron finished the sin offering, burnt offering and peace offering for Israel, what did he do toward the people?

answers.text: Lifted up his hands and blessed them
Sent them back to their tents

questions.question: When the glory of the LORD appeared to Israel, fire came from Him. What did it consume on the altar?

answers.text: The burnt offering and the fat portions
The breasts and the right thigh

questions.question: When the Israelites saw fire from the LORD burn up the offering on the altar, they shouted for joy. True or false?
